    points = [(r, c) for r in range(divider + 1, h)
              for c in range(w) if g[r][c] != background]
    if not points:
        return g

    right = max(c for _, c in points)

    for r, c in points:
        g[r][c] = background
    start = divider + 1
    for dr, row in enumerate(obj):
        if start + dr >= h:
            break
        for dc, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != background:
                g[start + dr][left + dc] = value
    stripe = start + len(obj)
    if stripe < h:
        g[stripe] = [8] * w
    return g
